quiet.name: At its own pace
quiet.text: Your charts meet at only a few points; putting into words what's between you may be more up to the two of you.

even.name: Balanced
even.text: Supportive and challenging aspects are close in number; your differences tend to give you plenty to talk about.

strong.name: Distinct
strong.text: Your charts touch at many points; where the bond comes from usually shows early on.

rare.name: Rare
rare.text: Two charts crossing at this many points isn't something you see often; it may be worth not taking what comes easily for granted.
